title: docs: e0b plan revision 2, two paths and proxy

commit.merge_subject: merge: docs: e0b plan revision 2, two paths and proxy

description: Records the owner's direction after reading Klipp: preview rides MediaCodec -> SurfaceTexture/OES with the first GPU step downscaling to the preview tier; export and the CPU-oracle parity ride ImageReader planes and our own EncodedColorSpec shader; an OES-vs-planes colour comparison on the same frame; a Klipp-style proxy as separate work (never play a half-written proxy). The Klipp claims were checked in its code (previewShort 1080, full-resolution export from originals, proxies). Not adopted: Media3 as a whole and KlippPrecision (not applicable to our own RGBA32F chain); Klipp is GPL-3.0-only overall, so only the architecture is taken, with a NOTICE entry for anything ported (K6). Acceptance tests are the owner's two clips.
